The merge island and block markings are visible. OSM and WEGGEG divide the approach differently, so a single count is unconfirmed.

The southbound A30 connector toward A12 narrows from two marked lanes to one at the hatch. The NWB offset order runs from two marked lanes to one despite the published 1 to 2 description.

Four painted turn lanes with four queue positions are visible at the sample cross-section.
The ramp has a marked merge and adjacent hatch. The published begin and end counts do not support a constant replacement.
The point section is by the same hatch and merge as WEGGEG record 18117. Precise physical lane allocation across the split remains unconfirmed.
